queries.name: throughput
queries.nrql: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req_per_min' FROM Transaction SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: latency_p95
queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: top_transactions_p95
queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: error_count
queries.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'errors' FROM Transaction WHERE error.message IS NOT NULL SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: top_errors
queries.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'count' FROM Transaction FACET error.message LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago
